purpose: Trigger-based broker follow-up questions for Oney Credit Framework deferral/rework workflow.

rules.question: Can you provide the full ATO integrated client account and current payment-plan letter?
rules.whyItMatters: Confirms whether tax debt is contained and managed, or evidence of recurring compliance stress.
rules.ifStrong: May support a controlled restructure narrative and improve lender-readiness.
rules.ifWeak: Rating likely remains Red; mainstream submission should pause and specialist/private path may be the only testable option.
rules.clientWording: Please send the full ATO account statement and current payment plan letter so we can confirm the balance, plan status and whether ATO is still comfortable with the arrangement.

rules.triggerLabel: ATO payment plan missed or defaulted
rules.question: What was the missed ATO instalment amount, why was it missed, and how quickly was it caught up?
rules.whyItMatters: Separates an isolated timing issue from ongoing inability to meet statutory commitments.
rules.ifStrong: May allow the missed payment to be framed as remediated rather than fatal.
rules.ifWeak: Conduct/compliance remains a major barrier and rating likely stays Red.
rules.clientWording: Can you briefly explain what happened with the missed ATO payment, the amount involved, and provide evidence showing it has been brought back up to date?

rules.triggerLabel: Superannuation / SG claimed current but not evidenced
rules.question: Can you provide SG payment or clearing-house evidence confirming super is current?
rules.whyItMatters: Unpaid super materially worsens compliance risk and can change lender strategy.
rules.ifStrong: Removes a major compliance uncertainty and may support re-rating.
rules.ifWeak: Deal may need remediation before lender submission; rating likely remains Red.
rules.clientWording: Please send the latest super payment/clearing-house confirmations so we can show payroll obligations are up to date.

rules.question: Can you explain each recent dishonour/excess and provide 6–12 months statements so we can see whether this was isolated or ongoing?
rules.whyItMatters: Bank conduct is one of the fastest ways a lender forms a risk view.
rules.ifStrong: May support a contained timing explanation if conduct has normalised.
rules.ifWeak: Rating remains Red/Amber and lender selection narrows.
rules.clientWording: Please provide 6–12 months business statements and a short note explaining the recent dishonours/excesses, including whether they have stopped.

rules.triggerLabel: Merchant cash advance or expensive short-term finance present
rules.question: Is the MCA being paid out, left in place, or restructured separately? Please provide the agreement, balance and payout figure.
rules.whyItMatters: MCA can materially distort cash flow and determine whether the proposed refinance actually improves servicing.
rules.ifStrong: Can clarify true refinance benefit and support a restructure narrative.
rules.ifWeak: Capacity may be overstated and structure may be wrong or under-sized.
rules.clientWording: Please send the MCA agreement, current balance and payout figure, and confirm whether the new finance is intended to clear it.

rules.question: What exactly will the working-capital funds pay for, broken down by major category and timing?
rules.whyItMatters: Distinguishes productive working capital from funding recurring losses or cash leakage.
rules.ifStrong: May improve purpose strength and support packaging.
rules.ifWeak: Request may need to be reduced, restructured or paused.
rules.clientWording: Please break down the working-capital amount into what it will pay for and when those costs are expected.

rules.question: Has any credible private/specialist lender confirmed appetite for this second-mortgage LVR, pricing and exit requirement?
rules.whyItMatters: High-LVR second mortgage structures may have no realistic secured path without specific lender appetite.
rules.ifStrong: May allow a specialist restructure path to be explored.
rules.ifWeak: Deal may have no realistic secured-lending pathway regardless of business story.
rules.clientWording: The proposed security position is tight, so we need to test whether any specialist lender would actually consider the LVR, price and exit before progressing too far.

rules.question: What happens if valuation comes in below the estimate — can the client contribute more equity or reduce the loan amount?
rules.whyItMatters: Valuation shortfall can change LVR, pricing, lender appetite and required equity.
rules.ifStrong: Supports lender strategy and fallback planning.
rules.ifWeak: May require lower loan amount, more equity or different lender path.
rules.clientWording: If the bank valuation is lower than expected, how much extra cash can you contribute, or what loan amount would still work?

rules.triggerLabel: Growth working capital linked to new contract
rules.question: Can you provide signed contract / purchase order evidence and payment terms for the new work?
rules.whyItMatters: Converts a growth story into evidence-backed working-capital need.
rules.ifWeak: Rating may remain Amber until revenue certainty and cash-flow timing are proven.
rules.clientWording: Please send the signed contract, accepted quote or purchase order, plus the payment terms, so we can link the working-capital request to confirmed work.

rules.question: Can the borrower service the debt if the external tenant leaves or does not renew?
rules.whyItMatters: Tests whether rental income is essential to servicing or merely a supporting mitigant.
rules.ifStrong: Supports Amber-to-Green movement if borrower can service without tenant reliance.
rules.ifWeak: Rent may need to be shaded or ignored; lender appetite may reduce.
rules.clientWording: Please help us confirm whether the business can still service the loan if the tenant leaves after the current lease term.

rules.question: Has zoning/permitted use been confirmed, and are there any known environmental or contamination issues?
rules.whyItMatters: Commercial property suitability and marketability can be impaired by zoning or environmental concerns.
rules.ifStrong: Improves security comfort and property due-diligence narrative.
rules.ifWeak: May require legal review, further reports, renegotiation or lender change.
rules.clientWording: Please confirm zoning/permitted use and whether any environmental or contamination issues are known for the property.

rules.question: Who owns the property, who is the borrower, and are any related-party leases, guarantees or SMSF interests involved?
rules.whyItMatters: Related-party security can create legal, policy and enforceability issues.
rules.ifStrong: Clarifies structure and prevents late legal/lender issues.
rules.ifWeak: May require solicitor review or a different borrowing/security structure.
rules.clientWording: Please confirm who owns the property, which entity is borrowing, and whether any SMSF or related-party lease is involved.

rules.triggerLabel: Stale pre-approval or old servicing position
rules.question: Can we re-run servicing using current income, expenses, debts, rental shading and lender policy?
rules.whyItMatters: Old pre-approvals can be unreliable after policy, rate, income, expense or debt changes.
rules.ifStrong: May restore confidence in lender strategy.
rules.ifWeak: Deal may move to Red or require debt reduction / lower purchase price.
rules.clientWording: Because the pre-approval is no longer fresh, we should re-check servicing with current income, expenses and debts before relying on it.

rules.question: What debt reduction, lower loan amount, additional income evidence or lender-specific pathway could bring DTI/serviceability back within appetite?
rules.whyItMatters: High income does not solve excessive leverage; DTI can be a hard strategic constraint.
rules.ifStrong: May identify a narrower lender path or revised purchase ceiling.
rules.ifWeak: No-deal under normal settings; rework before submission.
rules.clientWording: The total debt position is the main issue, so we need to check whether reducing debt, lowering the loan amount or using stronger verified income evidence changes the outcome.

rules.question: Can you provide an aged creditors report and explain any amounts over 60 or 90 days by supplier, amount and reason?
rules.whyItMatters: Supplier arrears can indicate liquidity stress and may affect trading continuity.
rules.ifStrong: May support a manageable working-capital/restructure story.
rules.ifWeak: Rating may remain Amber/Red and lender may require remediation first.
rules.clientWording: Please send an aged creditors report and explain any older supplier balances, especially anything over 60 or 90 days.

rules.question: What evidence proves the turnaround is real — current management accounts, new contracts, YTD revenue, margin and cash conversion?
rules.whyItMatters: A turnaround story only improves credit quality if it is evidenced and cash-generative.
rules.ifStrong: May support Amber/package-better positioning despite weak prior year.
rules.ifWeak: Treat as unproven; rating may remain Red/Amber.
rules.clientWording: Please provide the latest management accounts and any new customer/order evidence so we can show the recovery is real, not just expected.
